protocol.selectionMetric: paired daily net PnL improvement with unchanged risk, drawdown and tail-loss constraints
protocol.entryPolicy: existing configured canonical equity/ETF and closed-daily crypto breakout; same causal entry cohorts for exit comparison
protocol.barExecution: estimated, conservative stop-first when OHLC order is ambiguous; next observable bar execution, spread and slippage explicit; no observed bid/ask inferred from OHLCV
protocol.corporateActions: fetch official splits; exclude unsupported split-crossing paths symmetrically and report exclusions; never treat a split as a trading return
protocol.stress: double modeled costs, adverse intrabar ambiguity, delayed observations and partial fills
protocol.promotion: bar-based winner is research-only; no automatic production promotion or claims of real account returns
protocol.stopRule: one registered comparison; retain baseline if no robust winner; no retuning on test or holdout
protocol.scope: coverage and data limitations must be reported per asset; no invented option history or quote paths

limitations: Prices are historical OHLCV/VWAP; bid/ask and all fills are modeled, not observed NBBO.
Configured canonical entries only; 61 plugin variants are not 61 independently validated strategies.
No historical option quotes available through connected source; no option PnL simulated.
Missing bars are not interpolated; fills across data gaps excluded.
Universe chosen by existing release, not a point-in-time broad stock universe.
Three-second bar-arrival and 15-second signal/20-second order TTL cannot be reconstructed; bar fills are comparative research only.
Funded portfolio models single long entry, shared capital/exposure constraints and no borrowing; broker queue/impact and settlement not reproduced.
Intrabar adverse stop precedence; trailing updates at bar close, not a one-second production replay.
Crypto channel exit shared with native signal; no proprietary tape/ASTRA/options-context reconstruction.
